That's exactly what I was hoping for. I tried adding a link and the app went and filled in the title and description on its own — I just pasted and saved. And the "Read later" pile is right there in the sidebar with its count, I can drop things into it while saving or from a card, and marking one as read clears it out of the queue. Everything I saved sticks around too.

This does the job for me: I can save links without typing everything by hand, keep them organized in collections and tags, find them with search, star the ones I love, and keep a to-read queue that empties as I go. I'm happy with it.

<FINAL_ACCEPTED>
